entities.summary: The Lagos Central Mosque is a jum'at mosque, located in Lagos Island, Lagos, the largest city in Nigeria. The mosque serves as the principal home of the Chief Imam of Lagos. It is located along the busy Nnamdi Azikiwe Street.
